packet.claim: recover_json_object does not apply last-wins duplicate-key resolution to fenced candidates, so when the last fenced object has duplicate keys it is skipped and an earlier fenced object is returned instead.
packet.execution_evidence: kernel recovery returned {"a":1} for the reproducer
packet.scope: Replies with multiple fenced JSON objects where the last fenced object has duplicate keys and an earlier fenced object is strict JSON.
packet.source_basis: A candidate that parses as strict JSON, or as JSON with repeated keys resolved last-wins, is scoreable; The object scored is the last one inside a code fence when any fence holds one.
